title: Mantsoe a Pel'a Metsi a Khutsitseng
intro: Nahana ka sechaba se sa rehelloang ka lebaka la motse kapa 'musi, empa se reheletsoeng ka lebaka la metsi a khutsitseng ao bophelo bo bokanang ho 'ona. Ke litemana tse 'maloa feela tse hopolang sechaba sena, se lulang se thathamisitsoe har'a ba hanneng tataiso. Mamela ha ba bua ba sa bonahale.
clues: Re sechaba se bitsoang ka lebitso la Quran, empa pale ea rona e felletseng e ntse e patiloe ke sephiri.
Kamehla re boleloa hammoho le ba latotseng, joalo ka batho ba Ad le Thamud.
Re bitsoa Metsoalle ea Ar-Rass, Seliba seo bophelo ba rona bo neng bo tlameletsoe ho sona.
Re latotse lenģosa le rometsoeng ho rona ka tataiso e hlakileng.
Re baloa har'a ba ileng ba hana baromuoa bohle ba rometsoeng ke Allah.
Re ile ra tobana le tšokelo e ileng ea phethahala khahlanong le mohanyetsi e mong le e mong ea ka pel'a rona, timetso ka lebaka la ho lahloa ha rona.

identity.label: Ke mang?
options: Metsoalle ea Ar-Rass
Batho ba Madyan
Baahi ba Al-Hijr
Batho ba Lute
Batho ba Tubba'

trial.label: Nyeoe/Ketsahalo
options: O hahile tora e telele ho fihla maholimong
Ho latotsoe lenģosa le rometsoeng ho rona
O ile a rapela namane ea khauta ha Moshe a le sieo
Ba rera ho bolaea Yusuf ka lebaka la mohono
Ho batloa ho bona Allah pepeneneng
trial.answer: Ho latotsoe lenģosa le rometsoeng ho rona

location.label: Karolo ea Bohlokoa
options: Thaba ea Judi ea phomolo
Ntlo ea Borena e nang le Liipone ea khalase
Phula ea Bohloa
Areka e hahiloe tlas'a tšenolo
Seliba (Ar-Rass)

outcome.label: Sephetho
options: E metsoa ke lefats'e ka lebaka la boikhohomoso ba letlotlo
Areka e ile ea pholosoa moroallong
E ne e robalitsoe ka makholo a lilemo ka lehaheng
Taolo ea moea le jinn e fuoe
Ho timetsoa ka lebaka la ho latola manģosa
outcome.answer: Ho timetsoa ka lebaka la ho latola manģosa

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
